## **Poisons, Potions and Draughts**
## **New Weapon Quality — Slash (Xa)**
Slash weapons concentrate cutting power to open up gaping wounds. if you cause Critical damage with the weapon, the target takes a _Bleeding_ Condition in addition to any other effects of the critical hit. You may lose advantage to have your opponent suffer 1 additional _Bleeding_ Condition. 

Dark elves are connoisseurs of poisons and potions, and any self-respecting noble keeps an expert apothecary amongst their entourage, to formulate bespoke toxins and provide antidotes. 

**Barvalk.** A restorative liquor originally brewed by dwarfs, carried by dark riders to keep warm when travelling at night. Removes _Fatigued_ Conditions and reduces the effects of Cold Exposure (see the page 181, **WFRP Core Rulebook** ) by 1 failed Endurance Test. 

## **New Weapon Quality — Barbed Bolt**
a Barbed Bolt can lodge in its target if they take damage from the hit. Roll a **Challenging (+0) Dodge** test to avoid. if failed, the target falls _Prone_ and is dragged towards the Scourgerunner 1d10 yards in the chariot’s combat round. take dragging damage as page 26 of _**Enemy In Shadows Companion**_ **.** a **Hard (-20)** test is required to pull the harpoon free, which inflicts an additional Wound. 

**Hushalta.** Also known as ‘mother’s milk’, a thick, acrid liquid which speeds healing. It induces deep sleep with vivid nightmares and lingering hallucinations after waking. High doses can cause memory loss. 

## **Armour**
In battle, dark elves wear mail coats called _dalakoi_ , meaning ‘strength against death’. These are lined with deer or human skin and often worn under a breastplate. In daily life it is common to wear a light mail shirt, as violence is all too common in dark elven society. 

Dark elf helmets are tall, with an open face, sometimes covered by a visor, bevor, or chainmail aventail to protect the face and neck (this removes the _Partial_ Flaw). 

**Sea Dragon Cloaks.** Dark elf corsairs wear cloaks fashioned from the hide of a sea dragon. These proclaim their calling and offer protection from the elements and hostile attacks. They provide 2 AP to the Body Hit Location, with the _Partial_ Flaw. Wearers must treat their cloak with _vrasha_ (see below), and if it is not slathered in the unguent, the cloak begins to disintegrate. Each untreated week, it loses 1 AP, which cannot be recovered.
